result.summary: Overall layout is mostly clean, but there is one visible issue with a heart/favorite icon styling inconsistency and a partially clipped restaurant name.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has a white background circle while the one on the pizza card below has a dark/black background circle, creating inconsistent styling between similar UI elements.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button background across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel appears truncated with no ellipsis handling visible, though this may be due to edge clipping.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses proper ellipsis styling if the card is meant to be fully visible, or confirm this is expected carousel clipping.
